      "covers": "error:1"
    },
    {
      "name": "Invalid value for max flag",
      "given": "args = []string{\"--max\", \"abc\"}",
      "expect": "max = 0, files = []string{}, err = <error>",
      "polarity": "negative",
      "covers": "error:1"

```go
package cli

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

func TestParseArgs(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		args      []string
		wantMax   int
		wantFiles []string
		wantErr   bool
	}{
		{
			name:      "Happy path with max length and files",
			args:      []string{"--max", "20", "file1.txt", "file2.txt"},
			wantMax:   20,
			wantFiles: []string{"file1.txt", "file2.txt"},
			wantErr:   false,
		},
		{
			name:      "Empty arguments",
			args:      []string{},
			wantMax:   0,
			wantFiles: []string{},
			wantErr:   false,
		},
		{
			name:      "Only max length provided",
			args:      []string{"--max", "50"},
			wantMax:   50,
			wantFiles: []string{},
			wantErr:   false,
		},
		{
			name:      "Max length is zero",
			args:      []string{"--max", "0"},
			wantMax:   0,
			wantFiles: []string{},
			wantErr:   false,
		},
		{
			name:      "Max length is negative",
			args:      []string{"--max", "-1"},
			wantMax:   0,
			wantFiles: []string{},
			wantErr:   true,
		},
		{
			name:      "Missing value for max flag",
			args:      []string{"--max"},
			wantMax:   0,
			wantFiles: []string{},
			wantErr:   true,
		},
		{
			name:      "Invalid value for max flag",
			args:      []string{"--max", "abc"},
			wantMax:   0,
			wantFiles: []string{},
			wantErr:   true,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			gotMax, gotFiles, err := parseArgs(tt.args)

			if (err != nil) != tt.wantErr {
				t.Errorf("parseArgs() error = %v, wantErr %v", err, tt.wantErr)
				return
			}
			if gotMax != tt.wantMax {
				t.Errorf("parseArgs() gotMax = %v, want %v", gotMax, tt.wantMax)
			}
			if len(gotFiles) != len(tt.wantFiles) {
				t.Errorf("parseArgs() gotFiles length = %v, want %v", len(gotFiles), len(tt.wantFiles))
				return
			}
			for i := range gotFiles {
				if gotFiles[i] != tt.wantFiles[i] {
					t.Errorf("parseArgs() gotFiles[%d] = %v, want %v", i, gotFiles[i], tt.wantFiles[i])
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
```
